Source event earliest Stage1 signal is later of filing-next Qlib and independent accepted-next Qlib, four-calendar-month max age, AMD two qualitative events invalid. Exact issuer first-public/SEC public visibility remains unqualified.

single_mechanism.formula: Among two issuer latest original SEC forward sequential-revenue-growth values available before Stage1 signal and not older than four calendar months, fraction strictly positive: 0,0.5,1; missing otherwise.
single_mechanism.hypothesis: Broadly positive original forward revenue outlook from both AMD and NVIDIA indicates semiconductor demand breadth beyond original Stage1 price/VIX/market breadth inputs and should add positive H5 SOXX-versus-cash return information. Positive standardized coordinate coefficient required.
single_mechanism.baseline: Original frozen Stage1 39 primary features only
single_mechanism.candidate: Identical complete calendar, label, median imputer, scaler and Ridge plus exactly one original two-issuer guidance breadth coordinate
single_mechanism.regime_motivation: Stage1 full held 0bp cash opportunity and SOXL selection differ across weak/good intervals; issuer forward demand breadth is a new predecision fundamental mechanism rather than a hindsight interval switch. No threshold, sign, horizon or issuer selection from reused outcomes.

label.primary: Five consecutive original Stage1 SOXX funded open-to-open returns from signal s: sum j=0..4 log1p(soxx_forward_open_return(s+j)).
label.maturity: Original Stage1 timing.return_available_at of fifth interval; train mature before 2023-01-01 New York; held before 2026-10-10 New York.
label.role: Matched incremental information only, not fee-net strategy return.

model.baseline: SimpleImputer(median) then StandardScaler then Ridge(alpha=1.0) on original 39 features
model.candidate: Identical pipeline plus one fixed AMD/NVDA original guidance breadth coordinate

information_gate.paired_metric: Identical held signal rows baseline squared error minus candidate squared error for five-open SOXX log return

barrier: Run one no-fit Qlib DatasetH/source/maturity/predecision/novelty preflight, independent exact-code review, then exactly two fixed Ridge fits and one full-944-calendar paired bootstrap. Failed coefficient/full/halves/2024-2025/lower closes this version without sign, issuer, stale-age, season, lag or H5 rescue.
